definicaoChebi.texto: A nitrogen oxide consisting of linear unsymmetrical molecules with formula N₂O. While it is the most used gaseous anaesthetic in the world, its major commercial use, due to its solubility under pressure in vegetable fats combined with its non-toxicity in low concentrations, is as an aerosol spray propellant and aerating agent for canisters of 'whipped' cream.
